description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the 'Returns' model class for the 'Account' namespace in the OpenCart project. It contains methods for managing product return records, including adding a return, retrieving a specific return, listing returns with pagination, counting total returns, and fetching return histories.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling customer product return data within the 'Account' namespace of the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Inserts a new return record into the database and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific return given its ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of returns for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total number of return records for the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Fetches the history entries for a specific return, including status changes and comments.
